messages:
alex: Kicking off thread for tonight's cross-service change window (API + runtime + console + router). Deploy-bot shows slot at 23:00 UTC. Quick sync: console schema change, runtime TLS lib bump, and router header parsing tweak.

deploy-bot: Wave scheduled: wave-2026-03-01-C. Preflight checks: staging smoke failing for console v4 migration, runtime image tagged tls-2.0 needs approval. Docs: https://deploy.internal/wave-2026-03-01-C

jin: I saw the staging smoke failure. It's a minor migration ordering issue where saved-route index rebuild collides with an async writer. FWIW router has strict header parsing by default and will 400 if schema payload missing new field.

pat: Router can be tolerant via config flag parser.strict=false, but older API clients expect strict. We need a short compatibility window.

rosa: Runtime TLS lib bump (openssl 3.2) passes unit tests but our cert rotation job failed in staging due to handshake timeout on long-lived streams. I'm running extended smoke now.

alex: Proposed plan: 1) apply router parser tolerance in canary, 2) hold console migration in canary until runtime TLS extended smoke finishes, 3) if runtime flake persists, fallback is to revert runtime image to tls-1.9 and proceed with console only after patch. Thoughts?

jin: That plan sounds safe. The DB migration for console is reversible within 10m if we run the reverse script, but it'll require a brief failover. Need owner for rollback.

pat: I'll flip parser.strict=false in canary now. Monitoring logs for any unexpected client behavior.

infra-bot: Parser flag applied: router.parser.strict=false on canary-2. Change id cfg-9001. Logs replication enabled.

rosa: Extended TLS smoke: handshake timeouts reduced after bumping keepalive config in runtime. Still seeing a few transient errors during long streams but below threshold. I can add a temporary keepalive tweak config as mitigation.

alex: Two mitigations on table: a) revert runtime image (slower, interrupts other fixes) b) keepalive config tweak (fast, reversible). Which is lower risk?

rosa: Keepalive tweak is safe and reversible. It mitigates the handshake timeout without changing binaries. I'll propose runtime.conn.keepalive_ms=45000 for the wave.

jin: With parser relaxed and keepalive tweak, console migration should be fine. We'll document the compatibility window and plan to revert parser flag after 24h.

pat: Canary logs show no client-side 4xx spikes after parser change. Rolling to 20% once runtime keepalive applied.

deploy-bot: Applying runtime config: runtime.conn.keepalive_ms=45000. Change id cfg-9002.

infra-bot: Runtime canary metrics: p50/p95 stable, TLS handshake errors down to baseline. Proceeding to 20% traffic.

alex: OK initiating console migration in canary. Rollback owner: @jin for console, @rosa for runtime, @pat for router. Auto-abort criteria: >1% 5xx from API or >0.8% client errors tied to header parse for 5m.

pat: Starting console migration in canary. Watching for header parse logs and saved-route index errors.

infra-bot: Router canary logs: legacy clients accepted, 0.2% header warnings. No rejects.

rosa: Runtime metrics look healthy; keepalive tweak holding.

alex: If we see any major regression, we'll abort and run the console reverse script. Everyone comfortable?

all: :thumbsup:

pat: Ramp plan in deploy-bot: 20% -> 60% in 12m -> 100% in 25m if thresholds OK.

deploy-bot: Wave ramping: now at 60%. Monitoring thresholds.

infra-bot: Observed small latency bump p95 +18ms during 60% ramp, error-rate steady. No threshold breaches.

jin: Console DB migration completed in canary. No index contention observed. Pushing notes to wave doc.

alex: Proceed to 100%. Keep the parser flag in tolerant mode for 24h, then revert after verifying no issues. Create follow-up ticket to backport TLS handshake fixes into runtime image (INF-3500).

deploy-bot: Wave completed to 100% at t+36m. No auto-rollback triggered.

alex: Good work. Post-rollout action items: 1) INF-3500 runtime binary fix 2) Revert parser.strict=false after 24h if safe 3) Add one-line mitigation note to release notes: "temporarily relaxed router header parsing and applied runtime keepalive tweak; full TLS fix pending (INF-3500)".

jin: I'll own reverting parser flag after 24h.

rosa: I'll own the TLS follow-up ticket.

pat: I'll update wave doc with rollback runbook and owners.

alex: Closing thread. Please add the 1-paragraph note to release notes and tag owners. Thanks.
